chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not cut the bread with the knife, but break it by hand, and oppose the non-Arabs.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to break bread according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) prescribes breaking bread by hand to preserve its integrity and honor, distinguishing this Sunnah from the Persian custom of cutting bread with knives. This specific etiquette serves as a subtle marker of Islamic identity, encouraging believers to differentiate their daily habits from the customs of Al-Ajam (non-Arabs/Persians) while maintaining simplicity and reverence for sustenance.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not cut the bread with the knife, but cut it by the hand, and oppose the non-Arabs’.
en.sarwar: 14. Afi ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isa from Yunus who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not cut bread with knife, instead break it with the hands and do the opposite of al-Ajam (non- Arabs).”’
